title: Gray Code
description: Generate all 2^n binary strings of length n so consecutive strings differ in exactly one bit.
starter_code:
def solve(data):
    n = data["n"]
    # The i-th Gray code is i XOR (i shifted right by one).
    return [format(i ^ (i >> 1), f"0{n}b") for i in range(1 << n)]

starter_code:
def solve(data):

    # This construction is the bitwise XOR of row and column indices.
    return [[row ^ column for column in range(n)] for row in range(n)]
